<!-- Thanks for contributing! Fill in each section; delete the hints. -->

**Problem.** What does this change fix or add? Closes #

**Approach.** How you solved it, and anything you considered and rejected. If the PR has more than one commit, summarize them here.

**Where to look first.** The file or function a reviewer should start with.

**How you tested it.** If something can't be tested automatically, say how you checked it by hand.

**Docs.** What changed in `docs/` or the README, or write "No docs impact."

### Checklist (this is the [Definition of done](https://github.com/hackingerror404/ServiceChaperone/blob/main/docs/git-standards.md#definition-of-done) in our git standards)

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion on the linked issue is true
- [ ] One logical change, small enough to review in one sitting
- [ ] Docs updated, or this PR says "No docs impact"
- [ ] Branch is named `type/issue#-short-desc`, and commit messages follow the seven rules
- [ ] No secrets (tokens, passwords, webhook URLs), debugging leftovers, or stray files
